jobs.occupation: 176/2026 Junior Group Leader (m/f/d) in Computational Multiphase Flow (Ingenieur/in - Verfahrenstechnik)
jobs.description:
The Faculty of Process and Systems Engineering, Chair of Mechanical Process Engineering seeks to fill the following vacancy:

Junior Group Leader (m/f/d) in Computational Multiphase Flow

Salary scale:
13 TV-L

Date commencing:
As soon as possible

Fixed term:
3 years*

Contract status:
100 %

At the Chair of Mechanical Process Engineering (www.mvt.ovgu.de), we are a group of enthusiastic researchers with extensive research activities in the numerical modelling of multiphase flows. Our work addresses the fundamental physical mechanisms governing dispersed and interfacial multiphase flows, as well as their application to engineering systems. Current research topics include particle-laden and droplet-laden turbulent flows, particle–turbulence and droplet–turbulence interactions, the dynamics of non-spherical particles, interfacial flows, and compressible and incompressible multiphase-flow applications. Approximately eight PhD researchers and three postdoctoral researchers currently work in this area at the Chair.

The objective of the advertised position is to attract a junior group leader who will take a leading role in our computational multiphase-flow research. The successful candidate will contribute to and help coordinate ongoing research projects, while also establishing their own research direction within the Chair. The position offers excellent opportunities to develop an independent academic profile and to pursue a Habilitation. It therefore combines scientific leadership in existing activities with the opportunity to initiate new research topics and contribute to the further development of our numerical methods and simulation tools.

Our in-house simulation framework includes state-of-the-art methods for immersed boundaries, Lagrangian particle and droplet tracking, non-spherical particle dynamics, particle and droplet interactions, gas–liquid interfaces, large-eddy simulation, and fully coupled solvers for compressible and incompressible flows. You will also have the opportunity to establish your own teaching portfolio in areas such as numerical methods, multiphase flows, or particle technology.

*The position is full time for a period of 3 years with the opportunity to extend by a further 3 years.

Job description:

- Develop, implement, and analyse analytical and numerical models for multiphase flows
- Establish an independent research profile in computational multiphase-flow modelling
- Lead and coordinate the further development of our in-house simulation tools in C and MPI
- Develop research ideas and prepare proposals for externally funded research projects
- Supervise PhD researchers, postdoctoral researchers, and students working in computational multiphase flows
- Contribute to teaching in multiphase flows, numerical methods, particle technology, or related subjects
- Contribute to the scientific development and coordination of the computational multiphase-flow group
- Opportunity for further scientific qualification, including the possibility to pursue a Habilitation

Requirements profile:

- A Master’s degree or equivalent and a PhD in mechanical engineering, process engineering, aerospace engineering, applied mathematics, physics, or a related discipline
- A strong background in the physical and numerical modelling of fluid-mechanical or multiphase-flow problems
- Demonstrated research experience in computational multiphase flows, such as particle-laden, droplet-laden, or interfacial flows
- Strong scientific-programming skills in C, C++, or Fortran, including experience with MPI and high-performance computing
- Experience in developing numerical methods or simulation software; expertise in techniques such as immersed-boundary methods, Lagrangian tracking, interface-capturing methods, or particle-interaction models is desirable
- A strong publication record commensurate with your career stage, together with the ability to develop independent research ideas and contribute to research proposals
- Excellent written and spoken English, as well as a good command of German or a commitment to acquiring sufficient German proficiency for teaching and administrative duties within two years

For further information about the position, please contact Prof. Berend van Wachem by email, berend.vanwachem(at)ovgu.de

You will benefit from our structures and offerings in the fields of sustainability, diversity, family support and staff development. Our location in the center of a thriving, lively and family-friendly state capital guarantees a high quality of life and a wide range of leisure activities. For more information, please visit www.ovgu.de/en/karriere (http://www.ovgu.de/en/karriere) .

Applications from severely disabled people or people with an equivalent impairment will be given priority in the case of equal suitability, ability and professional expertise. Otto von Guericke University Magdeburg strongly promotes gender equality in all professional areas.

- Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

We are looking for someone who can make an immediate impact in a fast-paced, dynamic, and rewarding working environment. In return, we offer a range of opportunities for professional growth and career development.

The CRC 1774 investigates how key metabolic “promoter organs”-adipose tissue, bone marrow, the gut, and the liver-communicate with the cardiovascular system and thereby influence the progression from health through prediabetes and type 2 diabetes to cardiovascular diseases. - Identifying innovative technology solutions that reduce costs, increase efficiency and minimise risks is equally part of your responsibilities

jobs.occupation: Test Engineer RF Production Test Systems (m/f/d) for Wireless and Embedded Products (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
Principal Responsibilities:

- Designs and develops software applications and automation in support of manufacturing and engineering services.
- Provides input during engineering design and support reviews and prototype builds on functional requirements, product designs and potential issues as it relates to testing and manufacturing.
- Collaborates with design engineering and customer operations to establish new or redesign existing service programs.
- Ensures product meets internal and external quality requirements and customer specifications.
- Creates support and repair procedures and processes, writes troubleshooting guides and develops testing techniques.
- Trains operations personnel on support and manufacturing processes, product schematics, Approved Vendor Lists (AVL), Bill of Materials (BOM) drivers, applications and firmware functions.
- Compiles and maintains test-related documentation including test plans, procedures, results and reports.
- Identifies, investigates, and participates in opportunities to improve processes and procedures, to include various key performance metrics.
- Other duties as assigned.

Job Level Specifications:

- Degree in Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, Technical Computer Science, or a related field.
- Solid experience in RF and embedded hardware development, including understanding of RF design principles.
- Proven proficiency in test design and automation tools (e.g. Agilent ADS, Keysight VEE, LabVIEW, Visual Studio, Python).
- Hands-on experience with measurement and test equipment (e.g. network analyzer, spectrum analyzer, signal generator, protocol tester).
- Familiarity with regulatory standards and certification processes (ETSI, FCC, CE, RED, PTCRB).
- Basic knowledge of embedded firmware and hardware interfaces (e.g. SPI, I²C, PCIe, UART) is an advantage.
- Experience with DFM/DFT and structured development processes is beneficial.
- Analytical and structured working style with strong problem-solving skills.
- Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken

#Li-Tria
Work Experience:

- Typically 3+ years with bachelor's or equivalent.

Education and Certification(s):

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience from which comparable knowledge and job skills can be obtained.

Distinguishing Characteristics:

- May be required to travel.

Essential Functions

- Good understanding and experience with the development of mechanical design, manufacturing technologies, and embedding of electro-mechanical systems which may include vision systems, sensors, motors, enclosures, mounts and/or the integration of illumination, imager optics and electronics.
- Designs of parts and small sub-systems.
- Performance tests to check if the design meets specifications.
- Model interfaces with electronic and optical systems. Model thermal properties of the mounts and their interfaces. Model the design response to environmental shock and vibration.
- Definition of requirements and specifications for systems and components.
- Creation of drawings and specifications for optical and mechanical parts.
- Hands-on mentality.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

- Actively involved in engineering discussions. Ability to pro-actively communicate clearly, both orally and in writing in order to be actively involved in cross-functional discussions.
- Solid problem-solving skills for mechanical problems on a (sub-)system level. Strong attention to detail with the ability to debug, root cause, qualify, and modify electro-mechanical assemblies. Can effectively implement when given design direction.
- Knowledge of – or experience with mechanical production technologies, particularly injection molding, die casting, vacuum forming
- Possess strong time management and organizational skills with the ability to multitask multiple projects with quality and efficiency in a dynamic and fast-moving industry.
- Innovative and creative-minded individual who looks to continuously improve and challenge the ways things are done.
- Independent self-starter as well as a conscientious team player. Solid interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate with internal stakeholders to achieve project deliverables.
- Experience creating and maintaining BOMs, mechanical drawings, and assembly/process documentation.
- Exposure working with vendors for custom components and sourcing specific hardware for designs.
- Ability to use mechanical simulation tools (strength or thermal) or experience with designing optical or electrical systems.
- Experience prototyping your own designs using various fabrication equipment: mills, lathes, CNC systems, hand tools, 3D printers, laser cutters.

Minimum Education and Work Experience Required

- Typically requires 2-4+ years of mechanical product/design engineering experience or relevant technical experience. Experience with 3D CAD system preferably SolidWorks or equivalent.
- B.S. degree in Mechanical Engineering (preferred), technical discipline (i.e. Robotics Engineering, Industrial Design), or relevant equivalent professional experience.
- Must possess English language proficiency as a minimum for the role.

jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

Do you want to shape how a global manufacturing network thinks about data, AI, and the cloud? As a Solution Architect (f/m/d) Cloud & AI, you will  work within the Process Digitalization unit, you will design end-to-end solutions on Microsoft Azure and Snowflake that power production, sales, and finance domains alike. Also, you will lead the implementation of AI-driven workflows, e.g. integrating Azure OpenAI, building ML pipelines, and modernizing legacy systems, while also guiding executive leadership on strategic priorities. Every day, you'll balance ambitious architectural thinking with the satisfaction of shipping real, scalable solutions that move the organization toward a truly cloud-native future.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Designing scalable, secure Azure and Snowflake architectures by translating complex requirements from the global manufacturing network into future-proof cloud solutions
* Leading hands-on implementation of cloud and ML solutions by integrating Azure OpenAI into live data workflows and deploying robust CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps
* Driving modernization of legacy systems and automate data flows across production, sales, and finance domains to support a leaner, cloud-native organization
* Acting as a senior thought leader and sparring partner for Azure-based applications, owning the documentation and scaling of architectural designs across the organization
* Communicate architectural strategies and project outcomes clearly to both executive leadership and technical teams, bridging vision and delivery with confidence

What You Bring

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Cloud Engineering, or a related field, paired with many years of experience in cloud architecture
* Demonstrated expertise in Microsoft Azure and Snowflake including AI/ML integration, Python, SQL, and API development with a proven track record of delivering production-grade solutions
* Strong strategic planning and influencing skills: you're as comfortable shaping a multi-year architecture roadmap as you are aligning stakeholders across a complex, matrixed organization
* Experience with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps), generative AI services, and cloud-based modernization of enterprise systems
* You are business fluent in English; fluency in German is a strong plus

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical 

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

For Applicants applying from Austria:

At Siemens Energy we offer competitive compensation and additional benefits based on your performance, experience and qualification. Due to the Austrian legal regulations, we are obliged to state the minimum salary for this position. Please note that there is a clear willingness for a higher compensation considering your individual expectations, expertise and skills. The minimum salary for this position in the collective agreement for the electrical and electronics industry is in the amount of 54.439,39 € gross/year for a full-time position (38,5 h/week).

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

jobs.occupation: Process Engineer – Advanced Materials (all genders) (Ingenieur/in - Chemietechnik)
jobs.description:
Your Challenge

In your role as Process Engineer, you will be responsible for operating an AIXTRON CCS or Planetary system in our application laboratory. You will serve as the direct contact for the Simulation and Design departments regarding process optimization and further development of reactor hardware. In addition, you will work closely with colleagues from Sales & Marketing and conduct system demonstrations to support customer acquisition. You will also contribute to cooperation projects with internal and external partners.

- As a process engineer in the AIXTRON application laboratory, you will actively and independently shape the development and optimization of our deposition reactors and processes for compound semiconductor deposition
- Thanks to your independent and well-coordinated working style, you will plan and manage cross-departmental projects to further develop our deposition processes and drive the evaluation of hardware prototypes
- Your fascination with technology and your pursuit of perfection will motivate you to design and coordinate sometimes coompley test series with development projects
- Turning data into information: With your structured and scientific analytical approach, you will recognize complex relationships and draw conclusions from experimental series
- As a multiplier of our know-how, you will carefully analyze and document the knowledge and experience gained and share it with colleagues and team members
- You will be able to adapt processes developed in the laboratory to customer requirements and transfer them to customer systems, making a key contribtuion to ensuring our customers' rapid success

Your Profile

- You hold a degree in a scientific or technical field, e.g., Physics, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry, Materials Science, or a comparable qualification
- During your studies and professional experience, you have developed solid expertise in CMOS technology, advanced material deposition, semiconductor processing, and solid-state physics. In addition, you possess in-depth knowledge of epitaxial growth processes for both Group III–V and Group IV materials, which you confidently apply in practice
- You have process experience in semiconductor deposition, ideally using RPCVD on a commercial epitaxy system. Knowledge of other growth techniques such as MBE, ALD, or sputtering is also advantageous
- You are experienced in handling various characterization methods and solid-state physics-related questions and have worked with measurement equipment
- You have good written and spoken English skills
- You are flexible and open to international travel (approximately 5–10%)

What you can expect from us

- Flexible working hours: No fixed core hours, mobile working options, and the ability to switch between office and mobile office
- Vacation: 30 vacation days as standard, with the option to increase annually through salary conversion
- Profit sharing: Opportunity to participate in the company’s success and benefit from profit sharing
- Health: Promotion of your physical and mental health through regular health initiatives
- Further development: Continuous development through the AIXTRON Academy and individual support programs
- Retirement and additional insurance: Support for pension plans, capital-forming benefits, and additional insurance options
- Catering: Subsidized meals in the company cafeteria and fresh seasonal fruit baskets
- Open corporate culture: Open and respectful informal culture (“Duz”) across all hierarchy levels
- Sustainability and mobility: E-charging stations for cars and bicycles, good public transport connections, and free parking
- Employee referral program: Attractive rewards for referring new talent to AIXTRON

Homeoffice:
Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

Your Tasks

For the worldwide Field Service, we are looking for Service Engineers for our locations all over the world.

- It all starts with the installation and commissioning of machines.
- You will train the customers' personnel so that they also cope well without you on-site.
- Last but not least, you will support production on the customers' premises.
- In case you have the appropriate qualifications, you will also carry out the inspections and repairs, give advice on process-related matters, and support the customer operations.

Your Profile

- For this work, you have completed a degree in the sector of electrical or mechatronical engineering or as an industrial mechanic.
- It is desired that you have undertaken training as an engineer or foreman.
- You have gained appropriate professional experience as a skilled worker.
- We expect you to have good English skills and be willing to travel throughout the world.
- You are able to convince through your marked communication skills and ability to work in a team, your process-related way of thinking, and your ability to work autonomously.
